units.source_text: 叶子落下来的二楼临时看台上，斜着掉下来两三根架子上的木头，打在叶子的脸上，燃烧起来。

en.t: From the temporary second-floor stand where Yoko had fallen, two or three pieces of frame wood dropped at an angle, struck Yoko in the face, and burst into flame.

units.source_text: 叶子紧闭着那双迷人的美丽眼睛，突出下巴颏儿，伸长了脖颈。

en.t: Yoko had tightly closed those captivating, beautiful eyes, thrust out her chin, and stretched her neck long.

units.source_text: 火光在她那张惨白的脸上摇曳着。

en.t: The firelight flickered over her deathly pale face.
